Final for Publication

NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING AMENDMENT TYPE 1.
1749 N, Mozart Street
The subject property contains a two-story vacant 2-flat building on a 17’x 89’ lot

The applicant seeks to rezone the subject property from an RS3 Residential (Detached
House) to a B2-1.5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. The application is for a Type 1
Map Amendment to allow the applicant to convert the existing vacant 2-story building
into a single-family home and alter the front fagade by extending the front wall on the
northwest corner of the existing building with an infill addition measuring 3x3’ (9 sq.

ft. in area 4.5 sq. ft. per floor)
PROJECT BULK AND DENSITY
LOT AREA: 1,513 square feet or 17’ x 89”
FLOOR AREA RATIO: 1.5
BUILDING FLOOR AREA: 1,970 square feet
MINIMUM LOT AREA PER DWELLING UNIT: 1,513 square feet
OFF-STREET PARKING SPACES : 1
FRONT SETBACK: 0’-0”
REAR SETBACK: 30°-0”
SIDE SETBACKS: North 0’-0”, South 0’-0”
BUILDING HEIGHT: 25’-0”
ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENTS: 17-13-1000, 17-13-1003,17-13-1 003-EE
The project is in a Transit Served Location (TOD) located within 1,320 feet of the CTA
bus line corridor roadway segment (72 North).
17-13-1003-P Pedestrian Streets-Building Location Standards
17-13-1003-Q Pedestrian Streets -Transparent Window Standards.

17-13-1003-R Pedestrian-Door and Entrance Standards. Pursuant to sections: 17-13-
4100, 17-13-1101-A, 17-13-1101-B, 17-13-1101-D, variations are also sought for setback
reductions and are seeking all Zoning relief as needed and as allowed by the Chicago

Zoning Ordinance.
